newsitem.title: USA: U.S. soyoil weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. soyoil weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA soyoil weekly export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Net sales of 27,500 MT) were primarily the result of increases for China (20,000 MT--switched from unknown destinations), Hong Kong (10,000 MT), and Turkey (7,000 MT) being partially offset by reductions of 12,000 MT for unknown destinations.
Exports of 16,400 MT were to Hong Kong (8,000 MT), Turkey (7,000 MT), Mexico (1,300 MT), and Canada (100 MT).
